description: Defines the InspectableNativeWindow class and related functions for managing Windows Runtime native window types in a Direct3D 11 environment, including swap chain management and size handling.

classes.name: InspectableNativeWindow
classes.description: Interface for managing Windows Runtime native windows, including initialization, swap chain creation, and size management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Pure virtual method to initialize the native window with a given EGL window and property set.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a Direct3D swap chain with specified parameters.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the current client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: setNewClientSize
methods.description: Updates the client size and recalculates the swap chain scale if necessary.

methods.name: scaleSwapChain
methods.description: Pure virtual method to scale the swap chain based on window size and client rectangle.

methods.name: clientRect
methods.description: Calculates the client rectangle based on size.
